energy_unit_axis.equivariance: identity isomorphism on one trivial representation; group action and certification level are unchanged
energy_unit_axis.precondition: one statically known invariant energy_channel axis of size one

shared_edge_frame.contract: one official random auxiliary edge frame is shared across input, both blocks and force head while every to/from proof pair keeps a unique frame_id

stochastic_paths.alpha_drop: independent inverted-dropout mask on invariant alpha channels
stochastic_paths.attention_weight_drop: independent inverted-dropout mask after envelope weighting
stochastic_paths.eval: all stochastic primitives are identity maps and consume no mask RNG
stochastic_paths.ffn_drop: ordered scalar-path and S2-grid masks inside the explicit FFN
stochastic_paths.graph_drop_path: one graph-shared mask for the attention residual branch and a separately sampled graph-shared mask for the FFN residual branch
stochastic_paths.projection_drop: one irrep-instance mask shared across all m components of each type-l channel
stochastic_paths.value_drop: two ordered inverted-dropout masks: scalar SwiGLU output, then S2-grid product
